```yaml
name: Claude PR Critique

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  critique:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: bahmutov/npm-install@v1
        with:
          working-directory: web
          use-lock-file: true
          use-rolling-cache: true
          install-command: 'npm ci'
          cache-key-prefix: 'node-web'

      - name: Lint web
        run: npm run lint --prefix web

      - name: Typecheck web
        run: npm run typecheck --prefix web

      - name: Test web
        run: npm test --prefix web

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: bahmutov/npm-install@v1
        with:
          working-directory: apps
          use-lock-file: true
          use-rolling-cache: true
          install-command: 'npm ci'
          cache-key-prefix: 'node-apps'

      - name: Lint apps
        run: npm run lint --prefix apps

      - name: Typecheck apps
        run: npm run typecheck --prefix apps

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: bahmutov/npm-install@v1
        with:
          working-directory: electron
          use-lock-file: true
          use-rolling-cache: true
          install-command: 'npm ci'
          cache-key-prefix: 'node-electron'

      - name: Lint electron
        run: npm run lint --prefix electron

      - name: Typecheck electron
        run: npm run typecheck --prefix electron

      - name: Test electron
        run: npm test --prefix electron

      - name: Request critique from Claude
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-base-action@beta
        with:
          prompt: |
            Please provide a brief critique of this pull request.
            Focus on any potential improvements or areas for consideration.
            Be concise and constructive.
          model: claude-2
        env:
          CLAUDE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_API_KEY }}

      - name: Post critique as comment
        run: echo "::add-comment::${{ steps.request_critique.outputs.conclusion }}"
        if: always()
```
